name: Index YouTube Playlist
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  index-youtube:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - env:
          YOUTUBE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.YOUTUBE_API_KEY }}
          CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          CLOUDFLARE_VECTORIZE_NAMESPACE: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_VECTORIZE_NAMESPACE }}
          CLOUDFLARE_R2_BUCKET: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_R2_BUCKET }}
          YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST_ID: ${{ vars.YOUTUBE_PLAYLIST_ID }}
          YOUTUBE_CAPTIONS_ENABLED: ${{ vars.YOUTUBE_CAPTIONS_ENABLED }}
        run: |
          npx tsx scripts/index-youtube-playlist.ts
